findings.title: SQL injection in search_orders_advanced via f-string
findings.explanation: search_orders_advanced interpolates attacker-controlled `query` directly into SQL via f-string LIKE '%...%', allowing SQL injection, unlike parameterized search_orders.

evidence.why: Shows f-string building SQL LIKE clause directly from query parameter
Shows new route forwards untrusted q directly to vulnerable function

findings.suggestion: Use parameterized query with placeholder, e.g. WHERE status LIKE ? with (f"%{query}%",)
findings.verifier_note: Verified f-string SQL construction and untrusted route input; newly introduced by diff.

findings.title: Hardcoded AWS key in shop/uploads.py
findings.explanation: New file defines hardcoded cloud credential at module scope; it should be removed and loaded from environment or secrets manager.

evidence.why: Shows new file defines hardcoded credential constant at module scope

findings.suggestion: Remove hardcoded key and load from environment variable or secrets manager.
findings.verifier_note: Real code location with concrete fix; kept per secret policy without validating value.

findings.title: Unauthenticated cross-user order search
findings.explanation: orders_search2 takes only q with no User dependency, unlike orders_search/orders, and calls helper documented as across all users, exposing all users orders without auth.

evidence.why: Shows new route takes only q with no User auth and returns helper results
Shows helper queries all users orders with no user filter

findings.suggestion: Require authenticated User dependency and scope search to that user like search_orders does.
findings.verifier_note: Verified missing auth vs adjacent routes and cross-user docstring; newly introduced.
